response.justification: MOC-2004-0056 was raised at Cape Verity Export Terminal on 20 May 2004 as a scheduled change under engineering change note; no event precedes it in the record. The engineering change note record carries no clause change; it records the assessment only. The intent is to replace an existing requirement with one written to the current house style. The record reached the state merged in the change stream.
response.risk_note: No control is relaxed by this change; the residual risk position is unchanged or improved, and the key safeguard set is preserved.
